_**User**_

To achieve this behavior—defaulting to stacked or standard views on desktop and tablets, but forcing tablet-style side-by-side video feeds specifically on mobile screens—you need to adjust your CSS media queries so that the side-by-side rules apply *only* when the screen width drops to mobile sizes.

Here are the specific steps to configure this behavior:

Here is the updated portion of your CSS to implement this logic:

```css
/* Default layout for Desktop and Tablets (Stacked video feeds) */
.video-pair {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
}

/* Force side-by-side video feeds specifically on Mobile screens */
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .video-pair {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  
  .studio-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

```
